comment: Garage binary version contract — single source of truth for the garage binary across all nodes. Enforced by scripts/enforce-garage-vm-bootstrap.sh (check + enforce modes); consumed by tofu module garage_version values in main.tf (must match the 'current' version here). RCA 2026-09-01: the binary was previously outside convergence scope, so versions drifted silently; this contract closes that gap. Rollback: each node keeps /usr/local/bin/garage.bak-<timestamp> after an upgrade; restore by reverting 'current' here and re-running --enforce.

v2.2.0.notes: Shipped 2026-01-24. Snapshot-worker leak loop (MDB_INCOMPATIBLE + skipped cleanup) RCA'd 2026-09-01.

v2.3.0.notes: Shipped 2026-04-16. No breaking changes from v2.2.0. Includes worker-liveness fixes (LifecycleWorker uncooperative #1396). Changelog has no explicit snapshot-cleanup fix, so regression check [24] (MDB leak-loop detector) remains the operative guard.
